protocol.primaryMetric: Per-agent cumulative extrinsic reward; current full core minus frozen original
protocol.experimentalUnit: Seed; agents share one world and are not independent replicates
protocol.pairing: Identical common initial state, seed, agent count, shared parameters and step budget. Initial hashes cover the world, agents including learning arrays, and RNG states normalized to uint32.
protocol.originalExecution: Unchanged original inline declarations through Simulation, excluding startup. Original constructor/reset/step/collectMetrics execute with inert DOM controls. Only draw/updatePanels/toast are presentation stubs.
protocol.respawns: Counted without changing either implementation: energy <= 0 immediately before each step, per agent. Cross-checked against candidate counters.
protocol.timing: Setup and stepping, excluding initial-state hashing, source loading and final metrics; alternating order. Original uses a Node VM and candidate CommonJS, so these times cannot establish a performance advantage.
protocol.limitations: This is a toy simulation and one fixed 20-seed, 300-step, two-agent configuration. It does not prove superiority across configurations, original Nexus behavior, real-world tasks or all metrics. Bootstrap intervals summarize these seed pairs; seeds are a convenience sample, not a representative distribution. No parameter tuning is performed by this script.

source.note: Candidate hashes identify working-tree files, which may differ from candidateGitHead.

summary.interpretation: The interval favors the current full core on these seeds and this configuration. This does not isolate the contribution of any single change or establish universal superiority.
